engineering_notes: 0.1% absolute resistor tolerance does not guarantee matched ratio; worst-case ratio error for two independent parts is approximately 0.2%. Calibration and temperature analysis remain required.
For precision CV/CC nodes select C0G compensation capacitors; X7R decoupling effective capacitance decreases with DC bias.
This proof does not claim distributor stock or procurement availability.
Final R2129 antiwindup resistance is22k, RT0603BRD0722KL, verified against exact YAGEO part specification. The47k proof remains historical; no47k resistor is populated in final2100.
